Football Club''' ([[Greek (language)|Greek]]: ΠΑΕ Πανιώνιος Γ.Σ.Σ.), the ''Pan-[[Ionia]]n Gymnastics Club of [[Smyrna]]'' (Πανιώνιος Γυμναστικός Σύλλογος Σμύρνης, ''Panionios Gymnastikos Syllogos Smyrnis''), more commonly known as '''Panionios F.C.''' or simply '''Panionios''', are a Greek [[Association football|football]] club based in [[Nea Smyrni]], a suburban town in the [[Athens#Athens Urban Area|Athens agglomeration]], Greece. Part of [[Panionios G.S.S.]] (founded in 1890 in [[Smyrna]]), '''Panionios F.C.''' is the oldest football club in Greece.{{cite web|url=http://www.sport-fm.gr/article/podosfairo/paniwnios-i-istoria-tis-klironomias/3352445|title=Panionios' history from footballski.fr|publisher=sport-fm.gr|language=el|access-date=26 April 2017}} In the wake of the [[Greco-Turkish War (1919–22)]] and the [[population exchange between Greece and Turkey]], the multi-sport club [[Panionios G.S.S.]] was transferred to Athens. They have won two Greek Cups (in 1979 and 1998), while they were runners-up in the Greek Championship during the 1950–51 and 1970–71 seasons. They have won also the [[1971 Balkans Cup]]{{cite web|url=http://www.panionianea.gr/2017/12/photos_15.html|title=Panionios wins Balkans Cup|publisher=panionianea.gr|language=el}} and reached the quarter-finals of the [[UEFA Cup Winners' Cup]] in 1998–99 season. The team currently competes in the second division of Greek football known as [[Super League Greece 2]]. They play their home games in [[Nea Smyrni Stadium]] with a capacity of 11,700 seats."}}
